mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE has been below 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through joint demand signals.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% y/y) combined with rising policy rates (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through discounted cash flow compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% y/y and FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through supply chain disruption fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has been below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength that increases consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through joint labor signals.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increased >0.5% and UNRATE decreased >0.2pp in last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST > 1000 thousand units) supports consumer spending and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days in housing expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1000.
